dd-howmet-aerospace.overview: Pittsburgh-based Tier-1 aerospace supplier: jet-engine airfoil castings and rings, aerospace fasteners, titanium/aluminum structures, and forged truck wheels. Large, profitable, investment-grade (Fitch A-, S&P BBB+, Moody's Baa1); raised FY2026 guidance in August 2026.
facts: ~25,430 in 23 countries (end 2025); ~26% of US workforce unionized
Alcoa → Arconic Inc. (2016) → renamed Howmet Aerospace at the Arconic Corp spin-off, Apr 1 2020
John C. Plant, Executive Chairman & CEO (no succession announced)
RTX and GE Aerospace each ~11% of 2025 sales
Fitch A- (Feb 2026), S&P BBB+, Moody's Baa1
segments: Airfoil castings (blades/vanes), seamless rolled rings for jet engines & industrial gas turbines
Aerospace fasteners; now includes CAM and Brunner
Titanium & aluminum structural forgings, extrusions, titanium ingot/mill products
Forged aluminum wheels for commercial trucks
dd-howmet-aerospace.markets: 2025 revenue by market: commercial aerospace 53%, defense 17%, commercial transportation 15%, gas turbines 11%, other 4%. Defense grew 21% in 2025 and 11% in Q2 2026.
dd-howmet-aerospace.space_defense: Management names space, missiles, drones and CCAs as developing/defense growth areas (Mar 2026 Technology & Markets Day). No disclosed rocket-engine, launch-vehicle structures, composites, or named space customers. Plant said additive manufacturing isn't an attractive profit pool. Competitive pressure: SpaceX in-sourcing turbine blades (Aug) and GE Aerospace buying CPP for ~$11.75B (Sep 8).
dd-howmet-aerospace.ma: CAM (Consolidated Aerospace Mfg) ~$1.8B, closed Apr 6 2026 (~13x adj. EBITDA); Brunner Manufacturing ~$120M (Feb 2026); sold Savannah disk-forging plant ~$230M (Mar 2026). Buybacks $800M YTD through Jul 2026; dividend +17%. Stated appetite 'very selective' — profitable, segment-fit component makers; no venture arm.
red_flags: Grenfell Tower (2017): Arconic Corp indemnifies Howmet under the 2020 separation, but Howmet is a named defendant in the RBKC UK civil suit (trial expected Oct 2028–Jul 2029); Met Police investigation ongoing. Reputational, not a partnership blocker.
Environmental: 30+ cleanup sites incl. Superfund; $16M reserve; guarantees ~$1.14B of an Alcoa energy contract (remote).
Export controls: no ITAR/EAR violations disclosed (BIS/DDTC databases not checked directly).
Compliance screen: SAM.gov exclusions + OFAC SDN clear (Exos DD engine 2026-10-02).
fit: Exos buys or co-develops metallic parts; Howmet gets a flight-test window into space/missile/drone markets
